name: onmhj
description: Local AI-session capture with automatic final reports and ordered retries.

interface.longDescription: Captures Codex hook events to local JSONL, publishes deterministic daily evidence, and generates validated final reports through local Codex auth or an OpenAI-compatible API. Missing reports are retried in work-date order, and a date is confirmed only after raw, daily, report, and device confirmation are committed successfully.
